description: Average number of nights between check-in and check-out across booking records.
Distinct properties that appear in at least one booking record.
Count of booking records, including every status unless the query filters status.
Calendar month of the booking check-in date.
Current booking status: pending, confirmed, cancelled, or completed.
Sum of total_amount across booking records. This is booked value, not recognized revenue or payment receipts. The source declares no currency.
Unique property identifier recorded on a booking.
Public title of the property listing.

content:
## PURPOSE
- Answer questions about booking activity in the public Wanderbricks sample data.
- The audience understands basic travel and lodging terms.

## DISAMBIGUATION
- If a user asks for revenue without defining the booking status or accounting treatment, ask which definition they mean. Do not assume a booking amount is recognized revenue.

## DATA QUALITY NOTES
- The source does not declare a currency for monetary values.
- One booking row has a negative total_amount value.

## CONSTRAINTS
- Never label a monetary result as USD or another currency unless the user supplies that context.

## Instructions you must follow when providing summaries
- State the filters and date range used when they are not obvious from the question.

question: What is average stay length in nights by property type?

content: SELECT properties.property_type, AVG(DATEDIFF(bookings.check_out, bookings.check_in)) AS average_stay_nights FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_type ORDER BY average_stay_nights DESC, properties.property_type

question: Group unique property IDs found in bookings by property type.

content: SELECT properties.property_type, COUNT(DISTINCT bookings.property_id) AS booked_property_count FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_type ORDER BY booked_property_count DESC, properties.property_type

question: Show GBV for each check-in month.

content: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) AS check_in_month, SUM(bookings.total_amount) AS gross_booked_value FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) ORDER BY check_in_month

question: Show the 20 leading listings by GBV.

content: SELECT properties.property_id, properties.title AS property_title, SUM(bookings.total_amount) AS gross_booked_value FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_id, properties.title ORDER BY gross_booked_value DESC, properties.property_id LIMIT 20

question: How many bookings are there by check-in month?

content: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) AS check_in_month, COUNT(*) AS booking_count FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', bookings.check_in) ORDER BY check_in_month

content: SELECT properties.property_type, COUNT(DISTINCT bookings.property_id) AS booked_property_count FROM samples.wanderbricks.bookings AS bookings JOIN samples.wanderbricks.properties AS properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.property_type ORDER BY booked_property_count DESC, properties.property_type
